events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by in Las Vegas, dying six days later at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on music and culture. What's your favourite 2Pac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix today. His revolutionary guitar playing continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Celebrating The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' today. Which track from this legendary album is always on your playlist?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and attitude are unmistakable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: Imagine's Enduring Legacy
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' remains a powerful message of peace and unity. What does it mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember the iPod
angles.copy: Cast your mind back to when the first iPod dropped. Did you get one? How did it change your music listening?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Your Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Iconic Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Fawlty Towers or Monty Python moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Celebrating 'The White Album' from The Beatles. Which experimental track or hidden gem on this double LP do you love?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His electrifying stage presence and incredible voice remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: Celebrating The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' today. This album marked a pivotal shift in their sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon Remembered
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire hope and change around the world.
